description: ERC20 allowance across 8 EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Arc and Robinhood): how much a spender may move from an owner, and whether it is unlimited. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, arc or robinhood

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
